subject: vitest
detail: If you previously relied on running vitest from a subdirectory while using a config file from a parent directory, pass the config explicitly with --config.

test.error: FAIL: running vitest from a subdirectory used the vitest.config of the parent directory

source.quote: If you previously relied on running vitest from a subdirectory while using a config file from a parent directory, pass the config explicitly and scope test discovery with --dir. For example, bash $ cd subdir && vitest $ cd subdir && vitest --config ../vitest.config.ts
